description: Spec 028 registered study: the carried prior with its covariance inflated 4x in sd (k4, chosen on spent seed 361 by the rule in tl-n-refine.json, checked on 360) against ctl alone; the joint solve reported. Validation seed 362, test seed 363. Never edited after registration.

man2.what: Annex B targets, two or three periods with gaps

shift.what: shorter legs, smaller turns, more speed changes

rule.periods: after an engagement's first, rows as spec 025 (span bound below 0.5)
rule.gain: alone ÷ k4 in range: 'carried prior helps' if the engagement-bootstrap 95% interval is wholly above 1
rule.harm: 'carried prior harms' if alone ÷ k4 is wholly below 1 in range, course or speed on any split, or on the own-turn periods of the deciding split in range
rule.reported: k4 ÷ joint by the same intervals; the uninflated carried prior; by own turn; own rows; ties; coverage (4 dof) of the stated carried uncertainty
